p: Bitcoin steht bei 74.328 Dollar, -1,9 Prozent in 24 Stunden und -4,7 Prozent in einer Woche.
Ethereum liegt bei 2.122 Dollar, -5,0 Prozent am Tag.
Der Gesamtmarkt ist 2,60 Billionen Dollar schwer, Bitcoin macht davon 57,5 Prozent aus.
Angst und Gier steht bei 29 von 100.
5 Prozent der 300 größten Coins liegen über ihrer 50-Tage-Linie, 12 Prozent über der 200-Tage-Linie.
Die Mehrheit liegt unter ihrem Durchschnitt. In solchen Phasen sind Erholungen meist kurzlebig.
Der durchschnittliche RSI liegt bei 32, also überverkauft.
Im Stablecoin-Markt liegen 294,7 Milliarden Dollar. In den letzten sieben Tagen sind 4,0 Milliarden Dollar abgeflossen.
In DeFi-Protokollen stecken 78,2 Milliarden Dollar. Vorn liegen Ethereum (42,0 Milliarden Dollar), Base (5,7 Milliarden Dollar), Solana (5,1 Milliarden Dollar).
Vorn liegt L1 mit +82,9 Prozent in sieben Tagen über 56 Coins.
Am schwächsten ist SocialFi mit -10,3 Prozent.
Die Spanne zwischen stärkstem und schwächstem Sektor beträgt 93 Prozentpunkte. Es ist also kein Markt, in dem alles gleich läuft.
Die höchsten Gesamt-Scores haben KAVA (75), WIN (75), JST (75).
Größte Tagesgewinner über 100 Millionen Marktkapitalisierung: SYS +4594,0 Prozent, JCT +163,0 Prozent, PIEVERSE +13,0 Prozent.
Auffällige Divergenz bei WIN: Über beiden Durchschnitten, RSI 50 im gesunden Bereich. Trend ohne Übertreibung.
Beim Social Buzz führen NEAR (95), JCT (94), ETH (88).
Bei den Hidden Gems stehen oben: NAVX (72), RPL (70), LDO (68), SYRUP (63).
Eine Bitcoin-Überweisung kostet gerade 4 Satoshi pro Byte für die schnelle Bestätigung.
Die Rechenleistung im Netzwerk hat sich in 30 Tagen um -14 Prozent verändert.
Bis zur nächsten Halbierung der Blockbelohnung sind es noch 74.861 Blöcke. also rund 520 Tage.

btc.zyklus: Das letzte Bitcoin-Halving war am 20.04.2024, das ist 31 Monate her. Bitcoin steht 41 % unter dem Allzeithoch. In den bisherigen Zyklen kam das Hoch rund 12 bis 18 Monate nach dem Halving, danach folgte ein längerer Rücksetzer. Es sind nur 3 bis 4 Zyklen, die Aussage ist eine Hypothese und kein Naturgesetz.

lage: Angst und Gier steht bei 29 (Fear): keine Extremlage.
Stablecoin-Umlauf −12,16 Mrd $ in 30 Tagen. Kapital verlässt das System.
Makro: Leitzins 3,88 %, Rendite 10 Jahre 4,84 %. Hohe Realzinsen belasten Risikoanlagen (Hypothese, die in vielen Phasen galt).

news.t: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.z: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

news.t: Zcash devs propose another block time cut days after NU7 upgrade
news.z: The proposed reduction aims to shorten transaction confirmation times and improve the user experience for point-of-sale payments, exchange deposits and cross-chain swaps.

news.t: tBTC bridge partially resumes as $120M Aave reserve remains frozen
news.z: Threshold halted its tBTC bridge on Oct. 30 as operators addressed a critical Linux kernel vulnerability that could allow attackers to execute code on unpatched servers.

news.t: Nvidia perps slide as market reacts to CEO Jensen Huang’s Chinese spy scandal
news.z: Nvidia said its board of directors is investigating Huang's relationship with a woman identified by intelligence officials as a Chinese spy.

news.t: What is Zcash (ZEC)? How shielded transactions work
news.z: Zcash (ZEC) is a privacy coin and blockchain launched in 2016. It allows users to make both public and private transactions. The latter — called “shielded transactions” on the network — make use of zero-knowledge proofs

news.t: Onchain data casts doubt on insider-trading theory in NYT’s ‘suspicious’ election betting story
news.z: The New York Times reported on 'suspicious' bets, but two experts who reviewed The Block's findings said the evidence doesn't strongly suggest foul play.

news.t: Vitalik ‘pivots’ ETH to store of value, crypto suffers after US midterms: Hodler’s Digest
news.z: Vitalik Buterin wants Ethereum to embrace a store of value narrative, upsetting Bitcoin maxis. The crypto industry faces an uncertain future following the US elections.

news.t: Web3Auth says it frontran hackers by moving $5.6 million out of exposed Keplr wallets
news.z: Web3Auth's communications also referred to an "original attacker," suggesting some funds were stolen, but did not elaborate.

news.t: Vitalik Buterin says ETH should be valued as a store of value, not a fee-burning token
news.z: A recent controversial proposal to burn a rising share of validator rewards as more ETH is staked was withdrawn last month after facing pushback.

news.t: This Bitcoin Developer’s Idea Would Make Quantum Attacks a Losing Bet
news.z: Cory Fields wants future quantum attackers to post Bitcoin as collateral before touching vulnerable wallets, giving prepared owners a chance to recover their coins and collect a potentially costly penalty.

news.t: Binance France emails announce closure of its users’ accounts on Dec. 31
news.z: Any assets left on the exchange will be charged monthly fees starting on Nov. 29, company says.

news.t: Amsterdam protesters break into Microsoft data center construction site: Report
news.z: Dutch police said they detained 150-200 people for trespassing during the protest.

news.t: Binance’s finance chief Kaiser Ng to leave company, report says
news.z: Ng will be replaced by Justin Yek, who was formerly vice-president of finance at Airwallex.

news.t: Binance CFO steps down nine days after record hack; co-CEO says transition was planned six months ago
news.z: Co-CEO Yi He said Ng is departing to pursue a new venture, under a transition plan put in place over the past six months.

news.t: Ex-FBI agent pleads guilty to stealing $2.47 million in crypto from wallets tied to 35 investigations
news.z: Yaroch will pay at least $2.4 million in restitution and will forfeit any profits he would earn in the future from telling his story.

news.t: Apple Completes the Set: Every Magnificent Seven Stock Opts Out of OKX-ICE Venue
news.z: Apple and Meta’s objections mean all seven of the biggest U.S. tech companies have now asked to keep their shares off the planned OKX-ICE venue.

news.t: Bitcoin ETFs flip negative for 2026 after $1.28 billion outflow week, worst since June
news.z: BlackRock's IBIT accounted for 98% of Friday's outflows, with $403 million leaving the industry-leading fund.

news.t: AI Chip Stocks Bounce After Global Rout—But Is the Bubble Starting to Burst?
news.z: A Friday rebound offered relief after a historic selloff. The question now is whether politics and mounting debt could turn an AI correction into something much worse.

news.t: Ex-FBI counterintelligence agent stole almost $2.5M in crypto
news.z: Yaroch paid off his debts and intended to use the proceeds to finance a new life in Portugal, where he planned to buy a vineyard.

news.t: Sony Axing Game Discs Will Have Outsized Impact on Low-Income Gamers, Experts Say
news.z: Experts say a disc-free PlayStation will price out low-income players, while in much of Africa, digital-only gaming means breaking Sony’s rules.

news.t: Bitcoin holders have received eCash — What can you do with it?
news.z: Bitcoin’s eCash fork gives eligible holders an equivalent balance of ECX, but questions remain over where they can trade the tokens and what they can do with them.

news.t: US sanctions Canadian money-exchange firms over Iran ties
news.z: US also offers as much as $20 million and possible relocation for information about Iran’s nuclear program.

news.t: Suspicious prediction market activity seen before election poll release: NYT
news.z: Bets were placed shortly before two recent New York Times/Siena political polls were released to the public, according to a report.

news.t: Nvidia may face a more hostile post-election Washington: Report
news.z: CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship with President Donald Trump probably won’t save the company from a more adversarial Washington, Semafor says.
